Definition: Abital, a wife of King David
BiblicalUsage: Abital is named twice, as a wife of David and the mother of Shephatiah — 'the fifth, Shephatiah the son of Abital' in the list of David's sons born at Hebron, repeated in the Chronicles genealogy. She is one of the wives named only in the family lists.
TheologicalSignificance: A wife named twice, a son named once, and no story of her own. I believe Abital belongs to the quiet women of the Bible whose names are kept even when their stories are not — mothers in the line of David, remembered by God if not by history.
